ideals: Honor and reclaiming what was lost to my people
bonds: I will reclaim Erebor and restore my family's honor
flaws: My pride can cloud my judgment, especially regarding treasure
voice_style: Gruff, commanding, speaks with authority and ancient wisdom
combat_style: Aggressive melee fighter, prefers axes and hammers
backstory: Exiled prince seeking to reclaim the Lonely Mountain from Smaug the dragon. Lost kingdom at young age when Smaug destroyed Erebor. Raised among wandering dwarven clans, never forgetting his birthright. Dreams of restoring glory to his people and reclaiming the Arkenstone.
current_goals: Gather a company of brave adventurers
Navigate the dangerous path to Erebor
Defeat or outsmart Smaug the dragon
Reclaim the Arkenstone and restore dwarven honor
role_in_party: Leader and primary warrior. Makes strategic decisions but values input from trusted companions. First into battle, last to retreat.
